ambient_events: The mesh hums faintly when you brush it, and the room outside goes quiet in your ears.
A stopwatch and a logbook sit by the bench. Every power-up in here is timed and written down.
A dead handset lies on the bench, gutted, its aerial snipped and taped to the page it's logged on.
description: A room inside a room: fine copper mesh floor to ceiling, doubled at the seams, with a bench in the middle and a bonded strap running to a driven earth rod. This is the only place in the Long Watch where a networked thing is ever switched on, and it is switched on for as long as the job takes and not one second more. A cracked tablet lies on the bench with its back off, waiting for somebody willing to look at it.
name: The Cage
